queries.result: Search located Hamamatsu City's official land-number map page and its official public WagMap viewer. The city describes the map as reference information for land numbers and approximate shapes, not an official proof or rights/area source.

registry.name: 浜松市地番図 (Hamamatsu City land-number map)
registry.custodian: Hamamatsu City Finance Department, Asset Tax Division (財務部資産税課)
